page.notes: The Greek at the head of the page is faint; the first word and the letter before ἐμαρτύρησας are doubtful. The opening "cet" is the end of a word from the previous page and stays a fragment. The Greek is copied from the scan, not from a known text. The catchword "rum" completes the hyphenated "ite-" and is kept out of the text. Punctuation after "Editione" and "70" is faint and may be misread.
